correctness.rationale: The known kernel produces a lower-triangular absorbing chain with precisely two equal diagonal entries q2=q3=1/2, positive 3→2 transition, and strictly decreasing qj≤11/24 for j≥4. This yields the true size-two Jordan mode; its surviving amplitude αn is strictly positive by the explicit recursion and positive transition to three. Matching coefficients verifies αn,βn and all fixed-n boundaries. Exact n4 expansion shows secondary exponent sharp; rational first-step PGF and nonnegative tail prove moment boundary. Standalone exact script completed 1237 finite checks; theorem rests on the all-n proof, not enumeration.

value.rationale: This is a natural extreme-time refinement of a classic absorbing card-merger problem. The nontrivial 2–3-state spectral bottleneck yields a linear geometric tail instead of simple geometric decay, a sharp secondary decay constant, and explicit rational rare-event coefficients. These quantities distinguish rare long-merger behavior not described by the n-growing Gaussian limit and are useful for extreme stopping-time quantiles and exponential moments.
